title: Would You Survive These 8 Jobs From Old England?
title_alt: The 8 Worst Jobs in English History (Ranked)
hook: Imagine being paid to swallow a toad, eat a dead man's sins, or empty toilets by hand at night. These were real jobs in old England.
summary: We rank eight of the worst jobs in English history, from the ale conner who tasted every brewer's ale, to the Groom of the Stool who helped the king on the toilet, the toad eater, the sin eater, the saltpetre man who could dig up your floor, the fuller stamping cloth in stale urine, the tanner, and the gong farmer — with the real records behind each one.
pinned: Which of these 8 jobs would you pick if you HAD to choose one? 🍺🚽🐸🍞⛏️🧺🐄💩 Tell us — and what why should Wy answer next?
sources: R. R. Sharpe (ed.), Calendar of Coroners Rolls of the City of London, A.D. 1300–1378 (1913)
John Aubrey, Remaines of Gentilisme and Judaisme (1686–87)
Robert Chambers, The Book of Days (1864), "The Saltpetre Man"
David Cressy, Saltpeter: The Mother of Gunpowder (2013)
